This view tells the 2026 Field Marketing story end to end, from lead created to revenue recognized. The big number to watch is untouched leads — leads we generated through events but haven't followed up on yet.

1Funnel by Stage

Rows are months, columns are funnel stages. Each cell shows the absolute number on top and a conversion percentage below. Untouched, Worked and DQ percentages are share of Leads. MQL percentage is Lead to MQL conversion. SQL percentage is MQL to SQL. Revenue percentage is Pipeline to Revenue.

Click any month to expand by event. Click any number to see the underlying records.

2The Untouched Lead bucket

An Untouched Lead is a lead with no logged activity at all. No email, no call, no task, nothing. The SDR has not engaged yet. For Field Marketing this is the biggest leakage point: events bring volume, but if nobody touches them, none of it converts.

Why this matters. The hypothesis going in was that untouched rates would be higher for events than for other channels. The 2026 numbers confirm it. Almost 80% of FM leads in 2026 have no logged activity. That is the bucket to put in front of the SDR org.

3The Event × Month Grid

Pick any metric from the dropdown. Rows are events, columns are months. Click any cell to see the records behind it. Use this to compare events side by side: which ones generated the most volume, which ones converted, which ones produced revenue.

4The Untagged FM Opps row

Some opportunities are tagged Field Marketing through their primary or secondary source but have no event name filled in. They show up as "Untagged FM Opps" so you can see the volume without losing it from the dashboard. This is a CRM hygiene flag, not a data error.

5CRM Hygiene flags

Two patterns we flag for the Ops team:

  • Status not updated: Lead has logged activity (call, email, meeting) but SF status is still 'Untouched'. SDR did the work but didn't move the status.
  • Activity not logged: Lead status is Qualifying/Attempting/Worked but no activity is logged in SF. Either the SDR moved status without logging the activity, or the activity rollup is broken.

Use the CRM Hygiene filter to isolate these leads. Hand the list to Ops to clean up in Salesforce.

One question to bring to every conversation with this view. Of the untouched leads in front of us, which events produced them, and who should be following up?

Scope: 2026 leads, contacts, opportunities and members tagged as Field Marketing per the SSOT classifier. SQL/Win/Lost rows exclude role_category='Partnerships' and amount=0 to match the SQL Health Tableau dashboard. Lead count is at lead grain (raw lead + direct contact).
Region: derived from origin_country_c (lead/opp) or onboarding_region (member), mapped via marketing.country_region_ga4. Event Region: inferred from keywords in event_name (city/country/region markers); Unknown for virtual or generic-named events.
Lead status: activity-first signal — if last_activity_date is populated, status reflects SF lead status; if SF status is stuck at 'Untouched' while activity exists, we override to 'Worked' and flag as 'Status not updated'. If no activity and SF status is Qualifying/Attempting/etc, lead is tagged Untouched and flagged 'Activity not logged'.
